verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API platform with a CLI, an MCP server and self-hosted backends, so offering versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Changelog entries describe feature releases, not a versioned API contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
